violations.text: Hand sink base located in the front kitchen area was not in good repair, inspector observed cracks throughout with exposed wood. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (chlorine) sanitizing solution for the (3-bay sink). New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -chest freezer -residential refrigerator non-food contact surfaces shall be maintained clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

The floors underneath and behind equipment throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the back kitchen area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026
The floor in the kitchen area is in poor repair, inspector observed missing tiles. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

The walls in the (3-bay sink area) are constructed of (absorbent and non-smooth material). This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026
